verdict.rationale: First-party docs say shell integration lets iTerm2 know where your shell prompt is and lets you navigate to previous prompts with ⇧⌘↑/⇧⌘↓ (iterm2-docs-31, iterm2-docs-9, iterm2-docs-48). The GitHub README confirms it places marks at each prompt and that Copy Mode works with marks to jump between command prompts (iterm2-gh-10, iterm2-gh-8). Setup is documented via auto-loading, and triggers can stand in where scripts can't be installed (iterm2-docs-24, iterm2-docs-54). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of prompt/mark navigation.
